description: t.a applies envelopes to its own Cx (apply_child_capability_budget, cx.rs:2606): 100 memory bytes; then 500 memory bytes and 7 I/O bytes, which keeps 100 and adds the 7; then a spec that would tighten memory to 1 but requires an artifact envelope the Cx has none of, which is refused and changes nothing; then a 5-poll cleanup budget that is required and present.
